title: Ham & Cheddar Egg Bake
subtitle: Ham, cheddar, and eggs baked for easy portioning.
description: Diced ham and cheddar baked into a custardy egg base — slice into squares and hold warm for crews eating in shifts.

ingredients.name: turkey sausage or lean pork sausage
baby spinach
ingredients.notes: or chopped kale, sautéed and squeezed dry

ingredients.name: loaf day-old bread
ingredients.notes: cubed (optional), turns it into a strata

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 375°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan. If using bread cubes, toast them 6–8 minutes so the bake doesn’t go soggy.

steps.title: Build the pan
steps.instruction: Spread sausage, onion, and spinach in the pan. Add half the cheese. (If using bread cubes, fold them through now.)

steps.title: Egg mix
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika. Pour evenly. Top with remaining cheese.

steps.title: Bake to set
steps.instruction: Bake until the center is set and the edges are browned. If it jiggles like loose custard, give it 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Rest for clean slices
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes so slices hold for the line. Cut into squares; hold warm covered.

stationWorkflow: Assign one cook to the hot surface and one to assembly. Keep the line moving; don’t crowd the griddle.
Set a warm holding zone (oven 200°F or covered hotel pan) so staggered eaters still get a hot plate.
Run a quick call-proof check: anything crispy stays uncovered; anything soft stays covered.
cleanupNotes: While plates are served, scrape the griddle/pan and wipe with a damp towel (use tongs + folded towel).
Soak the mixing bowl and sheet pan immediately—breakfast starch sets fast when it cools.
leftovers: Cool fast: spread on a sheet pan 10 minutes, then portion into containers so it doesn’t sweat.
Reheat rule: eggs reheat best covered at 50% power or low oven heat; don’t nuke on high.
